pages.text: To recover an entity wagon, $(bold)hit an actual wagon part with a carpenter’s hammer$(reset). One strike returns intact parts with their wood and cloth colours. Cargo follows normal unloading rules, while riders and draft animals are released.

The hammer also chops wood like an iron axe, with equivalent durability and axe enchantments.$(br2)To mine world blocks near the wagon, aim at their exposed surfaces. This also works for grass and similar blocks appearing inside the box.

pages.heading: book.tm_wagon.recipe
pages.text: Four iron ingots, two logs or stripped logs of any type, and one stick.
